description.value: Fiore Famiglia is a neighbourhood Italian restaurant in Vancouver's west side, focused on 'simple Italian done right' with a full menu spanning lunch, dinner, happy hour, and takeout. It is part of a local restaurant group that also operates Brasserie Coquette and The Stable House Bistro, all sharing a community-gathering ethos. Cyclists in the Arbutus Ridge area will find a sit-down Italian option with a dedicated takeout menu and online or phone reservations.
